commandBridge.pattern: Commander anchored at the center line while operators form a functional arc around consoles.

twoFactionStandoff.pattern: Opposing figures hold separate sides of frame with civilians, cargo, or corridor infrastructure visually between them.

marketPressure.pattern: Principal characters move against a dense civilian flow rather than standing apart from it.

salvageCouncil.pattern: Shard captains occupy uneven heights and improvised platforms; authority is visible but not geometrically clean.
salvageCouncil.usage: War-moots, Triarch chambers, and internal Shard disputes.

mixedEscort.pattern: Different faction vessels or crews form one readable protective geometry around civilian traffic.
